text:
Maya (Product): quick thread30 reviewing the latest model catalog rows. main asks: badge density, pin affordance that survives navigation, and filter persistence.

Ravi (Design): uploaded updated frames: https://www.figma.com/file/new-frames. Summary: 1) show up to 3 inline badges then a "+n" overflow pill, 2) pin is a small button on each version row (visible on hover/focus), 3) pinned items appear in a compact chip area in the page header.

Lin (Eng): overflow is good rendering many badge SVGs slowed paint. implement +n as a simple div that expands into a lightweight list. for pin: prefer a real <button> with aria-pressed; hover-only icons are bad for keyboard.

Jules (A11y): agree on button. accessibility checklist: native button, aria-label="Pin version for compare", aria-pressed toggles, annouce changes via aria-live="polite" region, ensure color contrast >= 4.5 for badge text.

Maya (Product): customers want pinned sets shareable. suggestion: encode pins in URL query: ?pins=md1234:v2.1,md9876:v1.0. allow localStorage aliasing for long lists.

Ravi (Design): microcopy: debating tooltip text. options: "Keep in compare" vs "Pin for compare". lean towards "Keep in compare" (short, action-y).

Lin (Eng): implementation note: don't show toast every pin. update URL silently and use an aria-live note for screen reader users. only surface toast when user copies the share link or on failure.

Jules (A11y): for sparklines (metric badge popover) include hidden text like: "p95 latency trend: 100ms 15ms 90ms" or role="img" aria-label="p95 latency trend". also ensure keyboard can open +n and navigate items with arrow keys.

Ravi (Design): mobile fallback: move pin & overflow into row actions (three-dot menu). desktop: pin visible at focus, overflow opens popover.

Maya (Product): deprecated pinned versions: show placeholder row with CTA "Select replacement" and badge "deprecated". keep compare layout stable.

Lin (Eng): plan: on load, read pins from URL -> verify via metadata endpoint -> if missing, try nearest minor -> else mark missing. keep UI stable and show replacement CTA.

DesignBot: ticket created PROD-UX-449: catalog badges overflow + pin persistence. assignees: Ravi, Lin. due: 2026-04-09.

Maya (Product): thanks all. Ravi will update frames with keyboard flows, Lin will spike URL handling. Jules please add a short a11y checklist doc.

Ravi (Design): will push updated frames and spec by tomorrow.

Lin (Eng): will spike this week and report back in PR.

Maya (Product): perfect. ping me for copy tweaks. :thumbsup:
